'''Ruggle Schmong''' was a rogue [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designer. He created the designs for the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], which was produced for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Warfare" />
